bio.text: Amanda Marie Green is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, having won the August 2026 Democratic primary.

According to her campaign website, she was born at the San Diego Naval Hospital, raised primarily in St. Petersburg, and attended Florida State University, where she studied economics, international affairs, emergency management and public administration.

According to her campaign website, she was recruited by the largest implementing partner of the U.S. Agency for International Development and has served as an operations director and pricing expert; the site says she now lives in the Big Bend region.

sources.title: Amanda Marie Green wins the Democrat nod and advances to November for CD2
